title: Local triviality of a descended invertible module
statement: Let \(f:X\to S\) be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], whose tensor-pullback structure-module adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] is an isomorphism after every base change [def-pc-base-change]. Let \(M\) be invertible on \(X\) [def-sc-invertible-module], \(k:W\to S\) any morphism, and \(w\in W\). Assume there is a finite locally free module \(N\) on \(W\) [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] and an isomorphism \(M_W\cong f_W^*N\), with tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. There exists an open neighbourhood \(V\) of \(w\) such that for every open \(U\subseteq V\), the pullback of \(M\) to \(X\times_S U\) is isomorphic to its structure module. No properness, flatness, source direct image, derived complex, or family of target schemes is asserted.

proof.text: Identify tensorPullback with Modules.pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints to the same pushforward. The supplied descent isomorphism and preservation of invertibility by pullback make b^*N invertible, where b : X times_S W -> W is the second projection.

Test hO at r followed by k, where r : Spec kappa(w) -> W is the residue-field map. If Y = X times_S Spec kappa(w) were empty, Modules.isZero_of_isEmpty and pushforward.map_isZero would make the target of its structure adjunction unit zero. The isomorphism would make the nonzero structure module of Spec kappa(w) zero, contradicting Modules.not_isZero_unit. Choose y in Y. The pullback lift q : Y -> X times_S W satisfies q followed by b = the second projection followed by r, hence b(q(y)) = w by fromSpecResidueField_apply.

Choose V containing w and a finite free frame N.over V isomorphic to free I using the proved source-library Modules.exists_mem_over_iso_free. overIsoFreeEquiv and restrictFunctorIsoPullback identify V^*N with free I. On D = b inverse-image V, pullbackComp, morphismRestrict_ι and pullbackFreeIso give a free-I frame of the invertible restriction of b^*N. Choose a further trivializing open H containing q(y), regarded as a point of D. Pullback of the free frame to H is still free I.

H contains a point, so R = Gamma(H,O_H) is a nontrivial commutative ring by Scheme.component_nontrivial. appLinearEquivOfIso and freeSectionsEquiv identify the global sections of the same module with R^I and R. Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card and Module.finrank_self give Fintype.card I = 1. Fintype.card_eq_one_iff gives Unique I; coproductUniqueIso turns the frame on V into V^*N isomorphic to O_V. These are all proved source-library or Mathlib declarations, and this calculation includes the putative rank-zero frame by excluding it.

For U <= V, use W.homOfLE hUV and homOfLE_ι to pull the V-trivialization to U. For t : X times_S U -> X times_S W constructed by pullback.lift, its projection equations are t followed by a = a_U and t followed by b = b_U followed by U.ι. Compose pullbackCongr, pullbackComp, the pullback of the original descent isomorphism, the U-trivialization, and pullbackObjUnitIso. Finally compare tensorPullback a_U with Modules.pullback a_U. This explicitly yields the required isomorphism for every U, including empty U.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof. The local rank comparison is performed on a nonempty trivializing open above w, directly over its nonzero global-sections ring. The separate field-pullback rank-one lemma and residue-stalk comparison are unnecessary. The unit route is unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_descendedInvertible_neighbourhood
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) (w : W)
    (hM : ∃ (N : W.Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj M ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f k)).obj N)) :
    ∃ V : W.Opens, w ∈ V ∧ ∀ U : W.Opens, U ≤ V →
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (U.ι ≫ k))).obj M ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f (U.ι ≫ k)).ringCatSheaf)
